The '''2018–19 Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team''' represented [[Duke University]] during the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were coached by 39th-year head coach, [[Mike Krzyzewski]]. The Blue Devils played their home games at [[Cameron Indoor Stadium]] in [[Durham, North Carolina]] as a member of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. Led by tournament MVP [[Zion Williamson]], they won Duke's 21st [[2019 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament title]]. They received the ACC's automatic bid to the [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] and reached the Elite Eight, where they lost 68–67 to Michigan State.  Duke finished #1 in the nation in the final [[Rating percentage index|RPI rankings]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.teamrankings.com/ncaa-basketball/rpi-ranking/rpi-rating-by-team?date=2019-04-09 |title=NCAA College Basketball RPI Rankings & Ratings |work=TeamRankings.com |accessdate=April 1, 2023}}</ref>

==Previous season==
The [[2017–18 Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team|Blue Devils]] finished the 2017–18 season 29–8, 13–5 in [[2017–18 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in second place. They defeated Notre Dame in the quarterfinals of the [[2018 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] before losing to North Carolina in the semifinals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 2 seed in the Midwest region. There they defeated [[2017–18 Iona Gaels men's basketball team|Iona]], [[2017–18 Rhode Island Rams men's basketball team|Rhode Island]], and [[2017–18 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Syracuse]] to advance to the Elite Eight. In the Elite Eight, they lost to No. 1 seed [[2017–18 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball team|Kansas]] in overtime.
